item.title: The Toxic Truth Behind ‘America’s Next Top Model’
item.description: Reality Check: Inside America’s Next Top Model is a drama-packed, interesting watch for both avid fans of the show and those who know it exclusively from TikTok clips.

item.title: “Give Them Love”: Rev. Michael Davidson Builds Belonging as Montserrat Director
item.description: “How do I allow these students or these people—whether they're BC or in the parish—to feel that, despite all ways that the world may be polarizing, you're meant to be at Boston College?” Davidson said. “The only thing I have to give is to give them love.”

item.title: BC Beats SMU 77–59 for First ACC Win, Snaps 20-Game Losing Streak
item.description: Boston College women's basketball snapped a 20-game losing streak on Thursday night, outscoring SMU 22-9 in the fourth quarter en route to a 77-59 win. Lily Carmody put up 27 in the win.

item.title: Conner Leads Offensive Surge, Eagles Beat UNH 5–2
item.description: Emma Conner scored two goals and the Eagles beat New Hampshire 5–2 on Friday afternoon, giving BC a 2–1 advantage in meetings between the programs this season.

item.title: No. 12 BC Defeats No. 10 UConn 5–2 Behind Hagens’ Hat Trick
item.description: BC men's hockey beat UConn 5–2 on Friday night as James Hagens recorded his second hat trick of the season.

item.title: Asinine Lifts Thursday Night Spirits With Spring Improv Café Show
item.description: In Gasson Hall, on an otherwise quiet Thursday night, Asinine Sketch and Improv Comedy provided a lively respite from midterm stress with its Improv Cafè Show, creatively titled “Don’t Knock It Unless You’re Sure It’s A Door.”

item.title: No. 12 BC Knocks Off No. 10 UConn in OT, Sweeps Weekend Versus Huskies
item.description: With the No. 12 Eagles' 2–1 overtime win over No. 10 UConn, BC earned five total points on the weekend and sits at second in the conference, while UConn sits at third, two points behind BC.

item.title: No. 10 Michigan Outlasts No. 8 BC 10–9 in Double-Overtime Marathon, Eagles Start Season 0–3
item.description: BC lacrosse dropped its game to Michigan 10-9 on Saturday afternoon in double overtime.

item.title: Campbell and BC Shut Out BU 4–0 in Regular Season Finale
item.description: Boston College women's hockey ended its regular season with a bang on Saturday afternoon as the Eagles shut out Boston University 4–0 to sweep the season series. Grace Campbell tallied 24 saves for her fourth shutout of the year, and Ava Thomas added on two points to lead the Eagles to victory.

item.title: Eagles Fall to SMU 94–70, Lose Eighth Straigh
item.description: After taking a lead late in the first half, Boston College men's basketball saw Southern Methodist take control as the Eagles lost their eighth straight game by a score of 94–70.
